summary: We have bandied about for years around @Mozilla memberships. I say do it. People pay to WWF, Greenpeace, etc. Except have it come with a domain (and @Firefox as read/write browser) and give X Domains away around the world to other #Mozillians.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: We have bandied about for years around @Mozilla memberships. I say do it. People pay to WWF, Greenpeace, etc. Except have it come with a domain (and @Firefox as read/write browser) and give X Domains away around the world to other #Mozillians.
